summary: Schema-coupled behavioral conformance cases for operation contracts and their implementation artifacts.

source_role.rule: Operation conformance test IR is consumed by proof and migration tooling only; it must not become an ordinary agent startup surface.

preserve: representative success, error, and cross-target parity semantics
do_not_preserve: target-specific implementation details when a simpler IR case preserves the contract
duplicate primitive assertions inside composite operation tests
CLI invocation style when a direct implementation adapter can preserve the same contract
migration_policy.composition_rule: Primitive behavior is tested once at its own level; composite operation cases assume declared primitive contracts work and assert only the higher-level composition, routing, selection, aggregation, ordering, and boundary behavior.
first_migration_tranche: selected-output operation cases already represented by conformance contracts
structured operation error contracts for declared inputs
Python/TypeScript parity for generated operation artifacts with stable JSON output
handwritten_retention_boundary: live workspace inspection and mutation orchestration tests
generator internals and target adapter mechanics
CLI boundary tests whose behavior is wrapper-specific rather than operation conformance

adapter_model.default_semantic_path: direct implementation adapters execute JSON-shaped operation inputs and normalize JSON results before comparison; argv/stdout/stderr cases are wrapper-smoke proof until a generated operation-shaped callable exists.

adapter_kinds.description: Import a generated Python function, call it with JSON-shaped data, and normalize the return value or structured error.
Invoke a generated TypeScript/JavaScript function through Node and normalize the returned JSON or structured error.
Invoke argv/stdout/stderr only when the CLI wrapper boundary is the artifact under test.

adapter_model.normalization_rule: Normalization is declared by the case or operation contract where possible; adapters remain thin invocation and serialization shims.

semantic_coverage_classes.intent: An operation artifact accepts declared JSON-shaped input and returns schema-coupled canonical JSON output.
An operation artifact rejects invalid declared input through a structured JSON error contract.
Implementation artifacts preserve the same operation-level behavior after target-specific normalization.
minimum_case_shape: canonical JSON fields compared for parity

semantic_coverage_classes.intent: An operation or wrapper artifact respects safety, freshness, or ownership boundaries without retesting primitive internals.
minimum_case_shape: explicit retained handwritten-test rationale when not migrated

proof_output.routing_rule: Changed operation contract, schema, conformance, implementation artifact, adapter, or generated target paths should route to scripts/check/run_operation_conformance_tests.py before closeout when they touch migrated operation behavior; wrapper-shaped cases remain wrapper-smoke proof and must not be presented as default semantic operation proof.

external_readiness.rule: The operation conformance runner derives external-client scenarios from this existing authority and requires every applicable case across CLI JSON, generated Python, generated TypeScript, and the independently packaged client on necessary-surface and full-mirror installations.

initial_cases.title: Root defaults selected text output preserves selected-output contract

composition.case_focus: Selected-output operation behavior and user-visible text projection.

stale_when: defaults.report operation or artifact mapping changes
defaults.selected-text.process expectations change
selected-output envelope changes

replaces_handwritten_tests: selected-output operation behavior assertions for defaults.selected-text.process are represented by this IR case and executed by scripts/check/run_operation_conformance_tests.py
retain_handwritten_tests: CLI wrapper text-emission smoke where stdout formatting, argv parsing, or process exit behavior is the behavior under test
tests/test_generated_command_package_proof_runner.py::test_generated_python_conformance_uses_contract_artifacts remains as conformance-registry projection coverage, not behavior proof
migration.rationale: This case now uses generated Python and TypeScript operation callables for semantic proof. The retained stdout expectations document the wrapper-smoke boundary, but operation completion is proven without argv parsing through generated.workspace.python.commands.defaults_report:invoke and generated/workspace/typescript/src/runtime.mjs:invokeGeneratedOperation.

initial_cases.title: Root config rejects invalid generated option choice

retain_handwritten_tests: handwritten root CLI fallback parser tests
target adapter parser mechanics tests that do not assert the config command behavior contract
migration.rationale: This case remains wrapper-smoke because the invalid --format rejection is currently owned by generated parser/transport choice validation, not by the JSON-shaped config.report operation callable. It protects wrapper error behavior without presenting cli.process as operation-semantic proof.
